_purpose: ALIGNMENT GATE, second attempt. The first attempt used 2025-08-01 and returned INCONCLUSIVE: 21 scenes, ALL unidentifiable (peak/zero median 1.017 against a 1.15 bar), and 2.0 sigma even after pooling all 21 agreement surfaces.
_why_the_first_attempt_failed: Not scene count -- 21 scenes against a minimum of 5, every one with >70,000 cold and >45,000 wet pixels. Broad monsoon stratiform overlaps at any small shift, so each agreement surface is flat. Ranked against 1,646 surveyed IMERG granules, 2025-08-01's best scene came 649th: 152 heavy cores and 1.00% heavy area, versus 320 cores and 2.87% for the best day in the survey.
_selection: These are the top-scoring CELLULAR scenes from the survey, one per day. Score = number of separate >=5 mm/hr cores x heavy-area percent. Many separate cores give a sharp, unambiguous displacement peak; one big shield does not.
_imerg_already_on_disk: Every matching IMERG granule is already in data/imerg_survey -- these dates were chosen FROM it. No IMERG download needed.
_note_on_scan_times: INSAT 3RIMG scans at :15 and :45. For an IMERG half-hour starting at HHMM, take the 3RIMG scan at HH:15 (for S..00) or HH:45 (for S..30).
